jobs.note: Linkarooie: kangaroo operating an eccentric sci-fi signal selector

input.prompt: Original hand-drawn adult animated science-fiction illustration, 2D cel animation look. Confident dark ink contours with varied, expressive line weight; bold character silhouette; strong hard-edged cel shading in two flat tone steps; deliberately drawn dramatic perspective; cinematic square composition. Scene: an unmistakable large red kangaroo with correct powerful anatomy (long feet, strong tail, tall ears, deep chest) leaning forward on its tail and one paw, operating an eccentric retro-futuristic signal-selector console with the other paw. The console is understandable invented technology: a cross between a film projector and a radar dish, with reels, dials, a small round scope and a chunky lever. Many glowing transmission cards travel along a curved pipe into the machine; the kangaroo has just picked one interesting transmission out of the many and holds it up in its paw where it glows brightest — the focal event of the image. Background: a deep ink-blue night workshop, big industrial window showing a strange ringed planet and one small satellite, sparse stars, a few crowded shelves with odd tools. Palette: deep ink blue and near-black graphite shadows, warm off-white highlights, the kangaroo in rust-orange and warm tan fur, acid-green glowing accents only on the chosen signal card and a couple of dial lights. Small visual humour: one tiny purple space critter at the bottom corner quietly nibbling the pile of unpicked transmission cards. Entirely illustrated by hand; no photograph, no 3D render, no glossy plastic, no gradients, no glow haze, no text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures or watermarks.
